title: Saving and opening layouts
summary: File → Save, and getting back to a clean slate.

steps.title: Your dashboard is a file
steps.say: An Elastic layout is saved as JSON in your project at `src/main/deploy/elastic-layout.json`. The checkpoints read that file.

steps.title: Save
steps.say: **File → Save** writes your layout. Do it before every Verify.

steps.title: An old dashboard?
steps.say: Elastic remembers whatever it last had open, separately from this project. If you see a dashboard from another lesson, use **File → Open Layout** (Ctrl+O) and pick `src/main/deploy/elastic-layout.json`.

steps.title: Tabs
steps.say: Each tab is a page of the dashboard. Teams keep one for **Autonomous** and one for **Teleoperated**, so drivers see only what matters right now.
